title: Autonomy by Design: Preserving Human Autonomy in AI Decision-Support

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis and literature review evaluating how AI systems (specifically LLMs) predominantly embed WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrial, Rich, Developed) values and norms, risking unconscious and inauthentic value shifts for users from non-WEIRD backgrounds.

Analysis of prior empirical studies (e.g., medical image classification, social media opinion writing) to evaluate how human decision-makers subconsciously inherit, trust, and adopt the embedded biases of AI systems over time.

Conceptual discussion using examples from prior literature (such as AI-based resume filtering) to demonstrate how systems that exacerbate historical human biases can lead users to inadvertently make decisions that contradict their own values of fairness.
